code_style: AI-code. AI-generated attributed weak radiative-kaon leading and higher-order benchmark inputs.

explicit_conventions.loop_normalization: The independently stated G8=9.1e-6 GeV^-2 convention is retained without tuning to the rounded published virtual rates.
explicit_conventions.photon_symmetry: One real photon plus A-prime is distinguishable. Gamma(gamma gamma) is the zero-vector-mass rate divided by 2 epsilon^2.

unqualified_terms: The form_factor_model retains the historical leading-only calculation; higher_order_model adds the attributed a1/a2 unitarity loops and off-shell rho/omega exchange with all three massive-vector polarizations.
Unknown higher timelike operators and weak-vector counterterms are not universally bounded by this fixed declared model. No total measured branching-ratio factor is used to rescale it.
KL->pi0pi0 A-prime and KS magnetic/other current coefficients remain separate finite-current source models, not inferred from this radiative mode.
The single-virtual-photon radiative current is distinct from a two-photon dilepton amplitude and direct CP-violating K->pi0 single-vector matching.
Parent material transport, source exposure, BR(A-prime->muons) and full-chain qualification remain separate.

unitarity_model.normalization: All compact loop invariants and momenta in mK units; verified against unreduced dimensional tensors24-27; a_i dimensionful inputs include mK^-4 exactly once.
unitarity_model.uncertainty_scope: Independent parameter rectangle following the primary10-20percent theoretical input estimate; not a statistical confidence region or a universal higher-operator bound.

higher_order_primary_controls.primary_recoil_convention: The primary analytic formulas use one r_pi, but do not print their exact numerical mass card. The reproduction control explicitly adopts the common charged-pion mass for loop and recoil; this agreement is not proof of the authors unprinted inputs. Production retains the actual neutral-recoil mass.
higher_order_primary_controls.integration_scope: Independent conversion-spectrum integration without measured-rate rescaling; finite quadrature checks retained in regression tests.
